name: Ibiza Beach Party
summary: Ibiza Beach Party is a collection of Ibiza-themed mini-games. There are 44 in total, some of them including DJ'ing, cocktail mixing, jet-ski racing, crowd surfing, tug of war, cliff-diving and even a wet T-shirt contest. The games take place in six locations: hotel, beach, yacht, bar, nightclub, and campfire. There is a handicap, as there are no instructions, so you will only have five seconds before each game starts to figure out how to play it. The game includes two modes. In Survival you will have to play through all the mini-games to beat your high score, while time-attack mode is more about playing a single mini-game and trying to keep up as its difficulty increases.
